versions.changelog: Suggestions show as tables comparing each choice, with the recommended one marked, Jellyfin's description of each setting, and a reason. Related settings such as deinterlacing and tone mapping are compared in one table. Adds a 4K test suite. Fixes Intel low-power and library-video comparisons, suite steps that overwrote each other, and downloaded samples labelled as generated.

First stable release, replacing 0.19.0. Requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer. Third-party notices ship in each release archive with exact versions and licence texts, and release files carry build provenance attestations, checked with gh attestation verify.

name: HwProbe
description: Runs short test transcodes for each hardware acceleration backend and setting on the Transcoding and Trickplay pages. Shows which ones work, how to fix the ones that don't, and measures the performance of each. Recommended settings can be applied to Jellyfin's settings and reverted, or downloaded as a diagnostics zip to attach to an issue.
overview: Tests which hardware transcoding backends work on a Jellyfin server, and how fast each one transcodes
